parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, no visitor-facing facility ban, no documented police sweeps, detention-placement rule or trans-violence pattern — the dossier expressly lacks the tiers that place jurisdictions at 0.35 or below. The heaviest traveler-facing facts are a documented 2025 border incident in which immigration officers laughed at, mocked and questioned a trans visitor with no recourse mechanism, plus state suppression of public gender/sexual nonconformity (rainbow accessories barred even inside venues, LGBT themed shows cancelled, accounts scrubbed, foreign drag artists finding no space). Those are state-actor humiliation and expression-restriction — severity 2-3, official rather than crowd-sourced — not organised targeting. The conversion-therapy payout shows a narrow remedy but not one reaching visitors. Absent LGR, non-registration of LGBTI groups and gated transition care are resident-facing climate signals only, not deducted.
